records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official Metropolitan Police Service Dedicated Ward Officer Abstractions and Strengths dataset. It contains monthly aggregated activity to Team level and fields for Month, BCU, Borough, Borough Code, Team, abstraction status, abstraction type and abstracted minutes. On 27 November 2025 a Ward Codes column was added; the publisher warns those codes are derived from team names and may not precisely align with the exact areas they cover. The current resource spans August 2021 through July 2026. This batch binds the verified Campden ward code E05009390 as the target source-area key only; team/ward-code extraction, parcel spatial join and materialization are deferred to local OpenCode, so no DWO rows or parcel progress are claimed.
